title: 第9章 神只征战再传神谕第10章 吞并邻村完成个人任务
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
“信士总数量达到三百人……”
李越眉头微微一皱。
李家村算上外出的八人，也只有二百二十三人。
这其中五岁以下的儿童都有十八人。
也就是说——
除掉外出的八人、五岁以下的十八人。
他在李家村能够拥有的信士数量，最多也就一百九十七人。
还差一百余人。
“看来要在四周其他村子里发展信士了……”
他喃喃自语。
但现在他不确定的是——
蓝星穿越过来的三十亿‘野神’，有没有人在他附近的村子？
可以想象。
若是附近还有另一名蓝星神只，那他和对方之间，基本上不可能共存！
争夺信士，这是最根本的利益之争！
此时此刻。
他忽然明白了蓝星那些神话传说中，为什么神只可以为了争夺信仰而开启神战，乃至不死不休。
信士——
就是神只最重要的财产。
想要更多信士？

很多时候就要从其余神只的手中去抢！
哪怕你不抢，其余神只也会来抢你！
“让李有鸣安排人去打探一下吧……”
“只要知道哪些村子里的神只突然显了灵，就能知晓是否有蓝星神只存在了……”
他面色平静下来。
其余蓝星神只又如何？
他的供品百倍增幅，一下子让他获得了三百六十道神力。
而其余蓝星神只，此时肯定都还是‘野神’状态，没有晋升从九品，成为土地正神！
神阶高一个层次，那就足以轻易压死对方！
他打开最后的「神只征战」界面查看起来。
这个界面昨日他试过，还无法打开。
他猜测——
应该是昨日他还属于不入流的‘野神’，所以无法打开这个界面。
……
【神只征战】
【开启条件】：神阶达到从九品、成为神只超过一年
【开启所需】：百道神力「神阶每高一个层次，所需神力增多」
【开启效果】：
一、强制匹配一位神阶不低于自身的神只进行神战，神战分为三部分
二、神战第一部分——信士之战！

双方超凡信士进行征伐，信士之战失败一方，神只实力降低百分之三十
三、神战第二部分——属神之战！
双方属神或阴兵进行征伐，属神之战失败一方，神只实力降低百分之二十
content_en:
"The total number of believers reaches three hundred..."
Li Yue frowned slightly.
Counting the eight people who went out, there were only 223 people in Lijiacun.
Eighteen of them were children under the age of five.
That is to say——
Excluding eight people who are out and eighteen people under the age of five.
The maximum number of believers he can have in Lijia Village is one hundred and ninety-seven.
There are still more than a hundred people left.
"It seems that believers will be developed in other surrounding villages..."
he muttered.
But what he's not sure about now is——
Among the three billion ‘wild gods’ that Blue Star traveled through, is there anyone in the village near him?
One can imagine.
If there is another Blue Star God nearby, it is basically impossible for him and the other party to coexist!
The competition for believers is the most fundamental struggle for interests!
At this moment.
He suddenly understood why in the myths and legends of Blue Star, gods could start a war between gods and even fight to the death for their faith.
Believers -
It is God’s most important possession.
Want more believers?
Many times you have to snatch it from the hands of other gods!
Even if you don't grab it, the other gods will come to grab you!
"Let Li Youming arrange for someone to go find out..."
"As long as you know which villages' gods suddenly manifested their spirits, you can know whether there is a Blue Star god..."
His face calmed down.
What about the other Blue Star gods?
His offerings increased a hundredfold, allowing him to gain 360 divine powers at once.
The other Blue Star gods must still be in the state of ‘wild gods’ at this time, and have not been promoted from the ninth level to become the true gods of the land!
If the god level is one level higher, it will be enough to easily crush the opponent to death!
He opened the final "Godly Conquest" interface to check it out.
He tried this interface yesterday and couldn't open it.
He guessed——
It must be that yesterday he was still a low-level 'wild god', so he couldn't open this interface.
…
【God's Conquest】
[Opening conditions]: God level has reached the ninth level, and it has only been more than one year to become a god.
[Required to activate]: One Hundred Divine Powers "For each higher level of divine level, the required divine power increases."
[Enable effect]:
1. Forcibly match a god whose level is not lower than your own to engage in a divine battle. The divine battle is divided into three parts.
2. The first part of the divine war - the war of believers!
Extraordinary believers from both sides conduct a conquest. If the one that loses the battle of believers, the strength of the god will be reduced by 30%.
3. The second part of the divine war - the divine war!
Both sides are fighting against gods or yin soldiers. If the one who loses in the battle of gods, the strength of the gods will be reduced by 20%.
